name: handrail
description: Fail-closed deny/ask hooks for Claude Code: destructive shell, git force-push/reset, secret paths, prod-environment commands, package publish, remote code piped to a shell. Only tightens, never grants. The plugin is free (MIT); a paid pack with five more hooks is sold on Polar: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_JiIVHCFaBlH1jpGpbKWvb5nJX8v3kfJVsXMDD1cZtdU
